name: renovate-pins
description: Pins container images, Helm charts and operator-managed versions so Renovate keeps updating them: the pin shape per location, a tag-plus-digest regex manager for Helm values, the blind spots that freeze a pin while the dashboard stays green, fixing red and stuck Renovate PRs, approval backlogs and behaviour-neutral preset refactors, with a pin coverage script built on Renovate's extract report and an anonymous registry digest check.
